notes: CRISPRi strain LC-E18 (chromosomal ptet-dCas9) with a control guide or one of two guides that cause off-target dCas9 silencing; all induced with 1 nM aTc for 3 h in LB. Control guide = control (reference, induced, like an induced empty vector). The two toxic guides labelled knockdown; silenced genes not named in the text, so perturbed_genes and global_regulator_perturbed left out for them. Strain group not stated (LC-E18 only). No phase (3 h after induction, no OD).

inducer_added.q: Samples were harvested 3 hours after aTc induction.

treatment.q: Samples were prepared from E. coli LC-E18 harbouring psgRNAcos plasmids with 3 different guides (control guide, AGGAA_non1 and ACCCA_non1).
